# Max Use

> Calculate the maximum use concentration for a respirator from its assigned protection factor and the exposure limit, with training on PPE, air monitoring and HAZWOPER.

Max Use (https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs PPE Levels A–D, Air Monitoring, Air Monitoring & Gas Detection, 40-Hour HAZWOPER training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

Respiratory protection across the four PPE levels. Enroll: https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained?buy=585
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Air Monitoring & Direct-Reading Instruments](https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-air-monitoring-and-direct-reading-instruments): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Measuring what's in the air. Enroll: https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-air-monitoring-and-direct-reading-instruments?buy=583
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Two hours on gas detection. Enroll: https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Respiratory protection in depth. Enroll: https://respirator-muc.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
